_help: Settings for on-demand runs (Slack / Claude app). How a request becomes ads: CLAUDE.md. There is no daily automatic run: the client triggers every batch from Slack.
_drive_help: Ad Creative Pipeline (owned by agent@libracases.com): Research Briefs (n8n weekly brief), Outputs (one dated folder per request with Statics/Videos), New Products (one subfolder per product the client wants to test), Approved. asset_library_root = the client's raw footage library (shared by link).

Hobo Bag 3-Piece Set: Raw files/Hobo Bag 3 Piece Set + Hooks
Slouchy Vintage Bag: Raw files/ACH Creative Delivery/* Vintage Bag

_products_help: Product name as written in the brief -> library folders to take reference photos and clips from. Used by index_library/find_assets.

budget._help: Credits per BATCH (one plan = one batch = one B-number; a message for three bags is three batches, each with its own cap). max_credits_per_batch (voiceover + AI together) is 100, owner-approved 2026-10-20; plan refuses a voiceover over it unless --budget X is passed, and pipeline/ai_gen.py plans the AI part inside it (100 - voiceover - a retry reserve). Voiceover lines cost ~0.35 each, AI stills ~1 credit and clips 4.5-6; anything that fails its quality gate falls back to real photos / footage.

render._help: ~10 min per video on 4 CPUs. Bigger requests render and upload in chunks of up to 10 into the same Drive folder.
